seo.title: Brand & Design System · Precious Studio
seo.description: The Precious Studio brand and design system: story, voice, logo, colour, gradients, type, layout, components and motion.

story.name: Our Story
story.title: Good Design Is Felt Before It's Understood.
story.lead: Precious is a UI/UX design agency led by people, not templates. We design digital products for enterprises, growing businesses and international teams — and we design them the way a person would want to use them.
body: The name is a promise. Every product we touch is somebody's livelihood, somebody's idea, somebody's first impression. We treat it as precious: researched carefully, crafted by hand, tested with real people, and delivered with care.

We use AI where it makes us faster and sharper — but people lead every decision. In a market filling up with generic, auto-generated interfaces, that's the difference: work with fingerprints on it. Expertise you can see, and feeling you can sense.

positioning.label: Positioning Statement
positioning.text: For organisations whose digital products carry real weight, Precious is the UI/UX partner that pairs senior-level expertise with human feeling — because every decision we make is researched with, and designed for, real people.

facts.label: Archetype
facts.text: The Creator, with a Caregiver's heart — obsessed with craft, motivated by people.

facts.label: Audience
facts.text: Enterprise & corporate teams · SMEs & local businesses · International, remote clients.

voice.name: Voice & Tone
voice.title: Say It like You've Done It a Hundred Times.

voice.label: Voice
voice.text: confident, direct, expert, human. We lead with the answer, back it with evidence and stand behind it. Short sentences. Active verbs. No hedging.

rows.tone: Decisive — recommend one option and say why
Results first, stated as fact, with numbers
Calm and in control — what happened, what to do
Brief and assured — no confetti copy

rows: "Cut the sign-up to two screens. It will lift completion."
"We think it might be worth maybe exploring a shorter flow?"
"We tested it with 12 of your customers. Three things need to change."
"We leverage data-driven insights to unlock value."
"No — that will hurt retention. Here's what works instead."
"Great idea! We'll just try to make it work."
"We hopefully helped improve the experience a bit."
"That didn't save. Check your connection and try again."
"We design products people come back to."
"Elevate your digital journey in today's fast-paced landscape."

rules.title: Confidence Rules
rules.text: Lead with the recommendation. Use active voice and "will", not "might". State results as facts, with numbers. Own decisions: "we recommend", never "you could perhaps".

rules.title: Cut the Hedges
rules.cut: just, maybe, perhaps, kind of, sort of, hopefully, we think, try to, a bit, sorry
rules.after: (unless we're truly at fault). No questions where a statement will do.

rules.title: Cut the Slop
rules.cut: leverage, seamless, unlock, elevate, empower, delve, journey, game-changer, cutting-edge.
rules.after: If a sentence could sit on any agency's site, rewrite it.

closing.text: We're sure because we've done the research — so we show the evidence, credit the client's team and never talk down.

taglines.label: Taglines
alternates: Precise enough to trust. Human enough to love.

logo.name: Logo
logo.title: Wordmark and Butterfly Mark
logo.intro: The logo takes the text colour of wherever it sits: Deep Ink on light, white on dark. The butterfly is drawn on a 13 × 11 pixel grid.

animated.label: Animated Mark
animated.text: On the site the wings flap at 8fps. Hover it to send the brand colours through the pixels.

colour.name: Colour
colour.title: Primitives and Themes
colour.intro: Primitives hold the raw values. Semantic tokens give them a meaning and remap per theme; components only use semantic and component tokens. Click a swatch to copy its value.

semantic.label: Semantic Colour
semantic.text: What components use. Switch the theme at the top of the page to see each theme's values.

gradients.name: Gradients
gradients.title: Soft Washes
gradients.intro: Radial glows of the wash hues on a Slate 100 base, for button hovers, the team hub and the starting-point media. Never behind body copy.

type.name: Typography
type.title: Funnel Display and Funnel Sans
type.intro: Funnel Display sets Hero to H3 and statements; Funnel Sans sets quote to label. Display styles are title case except Statement, labels are all caps, eyebrows are title case.

families.sans: Quote to label: body, UI, notes and eyebrows
